author: Mark Atwood
text:
Filing as human alongside JMAP-jfia.19 / .7 / .20 / .21 / .23 / .26 / .28 / .29 — all are foundation-crate API-contract reshape decisions that ripple through every extension *-server. This one specifically: RESERVED_SET_ERROR_WIRE_NAMES is pub const; making it pub(crate) (the bead's recommendation) would break any consumer that referenced it for their own conformance tests.

Recommendation: defer to the major-bump decision. Options under that umbrella: (a) keep pub const, document the additive-evolution contract (additions are non-breaking by the type system); (b) move to a sealed accessor fn that returns Cow<'static, [&'static str]>; (c) make pub(crate) and accept the consumer migration. None of these are correctness fixes — pure API-shape decisions.
